model.description: Tower Three brings you Fruity Pebbles OG in a convenient 3.5g flower jar, delivering a nostalgic and flavorful cannabis experience. This premium flower captures the essence of the beloved breakfast cereal with sweet, fruity notes complemented by tropical and berry undertones. Each bud is carefully cultivated to preserve its vibrant terpene profile and potency. Fruity Pebbles OG is known for inducing euphoric and relaxed effects, making it perfect for unwinding after a long day or enjoying creative pursuits. The aroma bursts with a medley of fruity sweetness and earthy depth that translates beautifully into smooth, flavorful smoke. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or exploring new strains, this 3.5g offering from Tower Three provides quality and consistency in every session. Experience the playful flavors and balanced effects that have made Fruity Pebbles OG a favorite among cannabis connoisseurs.
